pro_course_detail.title: TUSOME KISWAHILI:  Swahili Comprehensive class (Language Learning)
pro_course_detail.description:
As your Swahili language tutor, I’ll guide you through a structured and interactive learning experience, customized to your level. We’ll focus on practical skills to help you speak Swahili confidently and fluently. At the end of each lesson, we’ll dedicate the last 10 minutes to practicing speaking, allowing you to apply what you’ve learned and improve your conversation skills in real-time.

Here’s what we’ll cover:  
- Phonetics, greetings, and polite expressions for everyday conversations  
- Pronouns, verbs, and tenses to form complete sentences  
- Noun classes and how to use them in context  
- Commands, counting, telling time, and numbers  
- Constructing positive and negative sentences  
- Associative, possessive modifiers, adjectives, adverbs, and syntax  
- Locatives, prepositions, and object and relative infixes  
- Full 1-hour Swahili conversation practice to improve fluency  

With every lesson, you’ll gain the skills to understand and speak Swahili naturally!

pro_course_detail.description:

pro_course_detail.description:

During our sessions, I’ll correct your pronunciation, tenses, and spelling mistakes, helping you build fluency and confidence.

pro_course_detail.title: DISCOVER EAST AFRICA: Swahili Essentials for Traveler
pro_course_detail.description:

This unit is designed to equip you with essential knowledge and phrases for traveling to Kenya or Tanzania. You'll also learn useful Swahili phrases for everyday interactions, such as asking for directions, making hotel reservations, shopping, and much more.  

Here’s what you’ll learn:  
- Swahili Culture – What to expect during your visit

Improving Speaking Skills: Dedicate 10 minutes daily to speaking in English—whether with a partner, tutor, or even by recording yourself.
Mastering Grammar and Writing: Complete 2 grammar exercises each week and write a short essay each month.
Enhancing Listening and Comprehension: Listen to a 10-minute podcast or watch a show in English every day.
We can break these goals down into smaller, manageable steps, and I’ll be here to support you every step of the way. 5. Technology Integration: I incorporate digital tools, such as language apps, interactive quizzes, and online platforms, to make learning more dynamic and accessible.
